notes: Present from 9.7; absent from 9.0 builds (live introspection, 2026-10-24).

functions.name: area
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the cross-section area of the pile elements.

functions.name: axial_yield
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the axial tensile yield strength (force units) of the pile element.

functions.name: component_id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of pile component id.

functions.name: density
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the density of pile elements.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.pilearray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{pile} or float{pile,3}
functions.description: Get the pile extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: force
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the force at each end of the pile using the force-moment sign convention.

functions.name: force_nodal
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the generalized nodal force acting at each end in the global system. The end 1 translational and rotational components are given first.

functions.name: gap
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the gap components in normal spring at each end of the pile element. The gap forms a rectangular shape in the pile cross-sectional plane, which is defined by the local yz-axes of the pile element node. The gap consists of four values denoting gap size in the positive and negative y- and z-directions. The components are the positive y-direction, negative y-direction, positive z-direction, and negative z-direction, respectively. The gap is always being tracked, but only affects behavior if the normal coupling spring gap-use flag function. The gap values for end 1 are given first.

functions.name: id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of pile element id.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return pile group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the length of the pile elements.

functions.name: load
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the uniform applied distributed load acting on the pile elements in the local y- and z-directions. The x-component of the return value will always be 0.0.

functions.name: local_system
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the local coordinate system of pile elements.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the mark flag of pile elements.

functions.name: moment
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the moment at each end of the pile using the force-moment sign convention.

functions.name: moment_plastic
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the plastic moment capacity in the pile.

functions.name: moment_plastic_y
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the plastic moment capacity in Y in the pile.

functions.name: moment_plastic_z
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the plastic moment capacity in Z in the pile.

functions.name: normal_cohesion
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the normal coupling spring cohesive strength of the pile element.

functions.name: normal_dir
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the global direction in which the pile element is being loaded by the coupling normal spring at each end.

functions.name: normal_disp
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the displacement in the coupling normal spring at each end of the pile element. Sign convention for normal spring is positive/negative, indicating separation/overlap.

functions.name: normal_friction
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the normal coupling spring friction angle of the pile element.

functions.name: normal_gap
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the normal coupling spring gap-use flag. True denotes gap is on, and False value denotes gap is off.

functions.name: normal_state
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the yield state of the coupling normal spring at each end of the pile element. Return values 0, 1 and 2 denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

functions.name: normal_stiffness
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the normal coupling spring stiffness of the pile element.

functions.name: normal_stress
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the stress in the coupling normal spring at each end of the pile element. Sign convention for the normal spring is positive/negative, indicating separation/overlap.

functions.name: perimeter
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the exposed perimeter of the pile element.

functions.name: poisson
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the Poisson’s ratio of the pile elements.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of pile elements.

functions.name: rockbolt
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of a boolean flag of the rockbolt. True denotes the rockbolt flag is on, and False denotes the rockbolt flag is off.

functions.name: shear_dir

functions.name: shear_disp

functions.name: shear_friction

functions.name: shear_state
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the yield state of the coupling shear spring at each end of the pile element. Return a values of 0, 1 and 2 denote never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

functions.name: shear_stiffness

functions.name: shear_stress
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the stress in coupling shear spring at each end of the pile element. Sign convention for shear spring is positive/negative with respect to the average axial direction of pile.

functions.name: slide
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of a boolean flag of slide. True denotes the slide flag is on, and False denotes the slide flag is off.

functions.name: slide_tol

functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the confining stress at each end of the pile element. (Negative value is compression.) Stress acts in a plane perpendicular to the pile axis; confining stress is the average of the principal values in this plane.

functions.name: thermal_expansion

functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the pile elements volume, equal to the cross-sectional area times the length.

functions.name: ydir

functions.name: young
